notes.title: Voice over volunteers for medic simulator
notes.content:
Hi,
I made a transcript text of medic simulator.  Please check instrctions file before recording
Welcome to recording info of Medic Simulator

Everyone who will record voice will get free game key and be included in credits.

If you want to record main character like Doctor or Nurse please send me sample audio file to s8cusyqr@gmail.com because only native speakers can record them. Anyone can record rest of the characters, including Jeremy. If you record Doctor, nurse, jeremy - characters that appear on many days, you need to record all of the days. Before recording a voice check below if given voice is taken. If not write name of the character npc and your name and write taken, something like that, so others won’t record twice same NPC:


Jeremy - Anna Hopf TAKEN (this is sample if jeremy is taken check below)


After recording please send files to s8cusyqr@gmail.com


List of NPC’s taken: UI is interface don’t record this!



Text game transcript:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iIhlzE_a4dB07r_dh0JLFjGF6eAgrkyH?usp=sharing
Instructions:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iUPpIc0ZOblYrhcDzML-0dlw1wS1BwFwtX9DiLrVBew/edit?usp=sharing

notes.title: Random voices during physical activity are now recorded by real people
notes.content:
HonestyIsKey recorded psychologist, random voices during physical activity and tolerance student answer.

Searching for voice over volunteers for Schoolteacher Simulator
I know that many people complain about soulless AI voices, so I am searching for volunteers to record voice overs for characters. Reward for anyone recorded is free game key and being included in credits.
Here is link to all voices from this game. If you choose to record man/jeremyfather/Player/jeremy/kitchen you need to record all audios, because it must be said by one person. Voices from random folder can be recorded by anyone and you can record any number of voices from there 1-many
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AKdIXzKndbIpSEeo-WtwUHAUwPjkh0-Y?usp=sharing
You can send me email with voice: s8cusyqr@gmail.com and your name/pseudonym to be included in credits and your email to send game key to after release.
